author: Kozmos
body:
So one day I was playing avicus minding my own business. playing nebula.
Guy flying, comes over. {for no apparent reason} and spleafed me.
later I find out that its peacheh the administrator. how wonderful!.
Also I see him flying around invincible and killing people.
Now don't get me wrong that sounds fun but isn't it an abuse of power?
I don't have evidence but there were many witnesses there.
point is staff need to not do that and its not cool at ALL!
[also I get banned for fly hacking :D just the best day ever!]
get banned at the hand of an abusive administrator.
its everyone's dream come true.
[this is not an appeal because I truly give up on this server thanks to the staff]
there used to be tons of people playing on avicus network!
until they started banning everyone.
until finally everyone's banned. and theres no one left to play. or they just choose not too.
Just pointed this out. hope it helps. you have officially ruined this server.
hope this comes as a good warning for everyone playing on this server not to move.
yet you might get banned for no reason. :D

replies.body:

If you're lying... then well, yeah, don't do that, it's misleading players.
